name: How to Extract Lossless Audio from a Video Stream Online
description: Step-by-step technical guide to extracting native bitstream audio (AAC or Opus) from MP4 or WebM containers with zero quality loss and no generational transcoding.

tool.name: Modern Web Browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

step.name: Provide Source Media URL or File

itemListElement.text: Paste a permitted media link or drag-and-drop a supported local container file (MP4, MKV, WebM) into the inspection card.
Review the FFprobe inspection card to confirm the native audio codec (e.g. AAC-LC 128kbps, Opus 160kbps, or FLAC lossless), sample rate, and channel layout.
Select 'Stream Copy (Lossless Demux)' to preserve bit-for-bit audio fidelity without re-encoding, or select a target format (MP3, AAC, FLAC) if required for device compatibility.
Click 'Extract Audio'. The media worker processes the demuxing job using safe argument pipelines and provides an instant secure download token.
